reason: I already pay for an IELTS course and I got burned by ELSA's surprise paywall, so I'd use the free 3 fragments a day and skip the trial; I don't want to remember to cancel before it charges me.
objection: A 7-day free trial that auto-renews feels like the same trap as before, and I'm not sure a pronunciation-only score helps my band when my course already covers speaking.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 3 fragments actually caught mistakes my teacher missed and worked with my mic without crashing, I'd pay for one month of Pro right before the exam, as long as I'm not forced into a trial.
